text:
maria-ops: Heads-up: embeddings service (eu-west1) started returning 503s ~08:10 UTC. Spike correlates with a small kv-cache change from last deploy. Rolling back would restore, but we want a targeted patch first. Requesting expedited deploy window (10m) to push fix and validate. /cc @sanjay @kelly @jordan-sre

deploybot: Automated check: recent deploy 2026-03-21T07:58Z by sanjay. Canary pipeline status: failed checks on canary-3 (latency + error spike). Recommended action: manual pin to stable or hotfix deploy. Available slots: now -> +15m. Use `/deploy hotfix` to proceed.

sanjay: I can build and push a quick patch to revert kv-cache tweak. Patch is trivial (revert commit f2b7d3). Will tag as v1.12.3-hotfix. Need approvals for canary skip?

kelly: Are we in a change window? It's within the daily high-sensitivity window but outage risk justifies. I approve expedited rollout to canary then 50% EU if metrics look good. Need on-call signoff from Jordan.

jordan-sre: On-call OK for 15m hotfix. Go/no-go criteria: canary error rate <= baseline + 0.1% and p99 latency not worse than +50ms for 5m. If any dataflow backlog or tokenization 503s persist, rollback. Otherwise we can continue.

olivia-pm: Add a short release note snippet and flag to customers in eu slack if this escalates. I can craft the note once build tag is available.

maria-ops: Quick checklist: 1) pin routing to stable for non-critical users if rollback needed, 2) postmortem template prepped at: https://wiki.redwood/internal/postmortems/embeddings-kv-cache, 3) alert channel is #incidents.

sanjay: Build complete. Image: gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:v1.12.3-hotfix. Ready to deploy. Command I'm about to run: ```/deploy hotfix embeddings --image=gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:v1.12.3-hotfix --region=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=5m```

kelly: :thumbsup: do it. I give expedited approval for canary.

deploybot: Starting hotfix canary (5%) in eu-west1. Pipeline id: pb-20260321-91. Running health checks (error-rate, latency, kv-cache misses). Notifying channels: #eng-releases, #incidents.

jordan-sre: Watching dashboards. If canary meets criteria in 5m, approve 50% roll to EU. If not, I will post rollback.

(5 minutes pass)

deploybot: Canary health update: error-rate reduced from 2.1% -> 0.08%, p99 latency -20ms. KV-cache miss-rate normalized. Canary flagged PASS.

jordan-sre: PASS from on-call. Proceed to 50% EU.

sanjay: Rolling to 50% now with command: ```/deploy roll embeddings --pipeline=pb-20260321-91 --target=50% --wait=3m```

deploybot: Rolling to 50% complete. Monitoring 3m.

deploybot: Rollout update: metrics stable, no increase in error-rate.

kelly: Approve final push to 100% for eu-west1. This is customer-impacting fix; proceed.

deploybot: Finalizing rollout to 100% in eu-west1. Estimated finish +4m.

(4 minutes pass)

deploybot: Hotfix rollout complete. All traffic in eu-west1 on v1.12.3-hotfix. Final checks: error-rate 0.05%, latency back to baseline. No active alerts.

maria-ops: Nice work. Jordan, please keep an eye for 30m. Olivia, ping customers if you think it's necessary. I'll attach the deploy log and a short release note draft to the incident ticket.

olivia-pm: Draft release note: "Resolved a regression in embeddings KV cache that caused intermittent 503s in eu-west1. Hotfix v1.12.3-hotfix deployed and verified. No data loss." I'll post to customer-facing channels after you add any technical details.

jordan-sre: Monitoring for 30m. If anything flares, we'll trigger rollback plan: `/deploy rollback embeddings --to=stable --region=eu-west1`.

kelly: Marking this thread as expedited-approved. Filing postmortem owner assignment to sanjay. Thanks team. :tada:
